**Total Estimated Remediation Cost**

**Total Estimated Remediation Cost: \$2,400,000** (\$1,850,000 for Area 1 + \$550,000 for Area 2).

These estimates are based on the following key assumptions: (i) remediation is performed in conjunction with site development earthwork, allowing shared mobilization and equipment costs; (ii) a CT DEEP-approved Remedial Action Plan (\"RAP\") is in place prior to commencement of remediation activities; (iii) contaminated soil is transported to and disposed of at a licensed solid waste disposal or treatment facility in Connecticut or a neighboring state; and (iv) groundwater dewatering and treatment are not required during excavation. Costs could increase materially if contamination is found to extend beyond the delineated areas during excavation, if unanticipated contaminants are encountered, or if groundwater dewatering and on-site treatment are required to maintain dry working conditions during excavation.

These cost estimates do not include the cost of maintaining or modifying the existing ELUR, obtaining any necessary CT DEEP approvals or permits, preparing the required Remedial Action Plan and post-remediation Verification Report, or any legal or consulting fees associated with ELUR compliance. These cost estimates also do not include the cost of bulkhead repair or replacement, which should be estimated separately based on the recommended structural engineering assessment.

**Allocation Note:** Halcyon understands from the Client that the parties to the proposed ground lease transaction are negotiating the allocation of environmental remediation costs between the Authority (as Landlord) and the Client (as Tenant). The Client has indicated that the Authority has agreed to provide a **\$1,800,000 credit** against lease rent payments to offset remediation costs, which would leave approximately **\$600,000** (\$2,400,000 − \$1,800,000 = \$600,000) as the Tenant\'s financial responsibility for environmental remediation. Halcyon takes no position on the appropriateness of this allocation but notes the figures here for the completeness of this executive summary and to facilitate the Client\'s financial due diligence.

**[7. Conclusions and Recommendations]{.underline}**

**Conclusions.** The Phase II Environmental Site Assessment confirmed the presence of petroleum hydrocarbon contamination in two discrete areas of the Subject Property, both attributable to the Property\'s historical use as a ship repair and dry dock facility from approximately 1942 through 1987. Both contamination areas exceed Connecticut RSR Residential Direct Exposure Criteria for Total Petroleum Hydrocarbons, with maximum concentrations of 3,800 mg/kg in Area 1 (Northwest Corner / Former UST Area) and 1,200 mg/kg in Area 2 (Former Dry Dock Area), compared to the applicable RDEC threshold of 500 mg/kg.

The contamination in both areas is laterally and vertically delineated based on the sampling program. Perimeter borings in both areas showed TPH concentrations below the 500 mg/kg RDEC, and samples at deeper intervals (15--20 feet bgs) were below applicable thresholds. Groundwater sampling results indicate that the petroleum hydrocarbon contamination has not resulted in significant groundwater impact, and the contamination does not appear to have migrated off-site based on the available data.

The existing ELUR recorded at Volume 412, Page 88 of the Port Calloway Land Records imposes land use restrictions that are consistent with the investigation findings. The ELUR must be maintained unless the Property is fully remediated to unrestricted-use standards under the Connecticut RSRs, which would require significantly greater remediation expenditures than the estimates presented in this report and is not currently contemplated by the Client.

**Recommendations.** Based on the findings of this Phase II ESA, Halcyon provides the following recommendations for the Client\'s consideration:

> **1. Remediation.** Proceed with excavation and off-site disposal of contaminated soils in both Area 1 (approximately 3,100 cubic yards) and Area 2 (approximately 600 cubic yards) in conjunction with site development earthwork. All remediation activities should be conducted under a CT DEEP-approved Remedial Action Plan, with confirmation sampling to verify that post-excavation conditions meet applicable RSR criteria. The estimated total remediation cost is \$2,400,000, subject to the assumptions and qualifications stated in Section 6 above.
>
> **2. ELUR Compliance --- Ground-Floor Residential Use Restriction.** Ensure that the proposed development design and any ground lease agreement are fully consistent with the ELUR\'s restrictions, particularly the prohibition on ground-floor residential use. As discussed in Section 2.3 of this report, the ELUR prohibits residential use on the ground floor but does not expressly address non-habitable ancillary spaces such as residential lobbies, fitness centers, amenity rooms, and leasing offices. The Client should seek formal clarification from CT DEEP regarding the permissibility of residential lobby and amenity spaces on the ground floor before finalizing the project design and lease terms. In the absence of such clarification, ground-floor uses should be limited to commercial, retail, and clearly non-habitable ancillary building functions. Additionally, any affordable housing units included in the development should be located exclusively on upper floors of the residential tower to ensure compliance with the ELUR prohibition.
>
> **3. Engineered Barrier.** Maintain or reconstruct an engineered barrier (cap) over contaminated areas in accordance with the ELUR requirements. Construction plans should incorporate the ELUR-required 24-inch layer of documented clean fill or an equivalent geomembrane/concrete barrier system, with provisions for inspection, maintenance, and repair. The development\'s site grading and foundation design should be coordinated with the engineered barrier requirements to ensure that the barrier is not compromised during or after construction.
>
> **4. Soil Management Plan.** Develop and obtain CT DEEP approval of a Soil Management Plan (\"SMP\") prior to any ground disturbance on the Subject Property. The SMP should address procedures for handling, characterizing, stockpiling, and disposing of soil encountered during construction, including protocols for unexpected contamination discovery, worker health and safety, dust control, and stormwater management during excavation activities.
>
> **5. Flood Resilience and Freeboard.** Evaluate whether the proposed 3-foot freeboard (FFE of 15 feet NAVD88 above BFE of 12 feet NAVD88) is adequate for the 99-year anticipated lease term, given evolving Connecticut coastal resilience standards and sea level rise projections. As discussed in Section 5, recent legislative developments (including Connecticut Public Act 23-167) and emerging municipal standards in coastal Connecticut communities suggest that 4 to 5 feet of freeboard may become the standard for new waterfront construction. Consider increasing the FFE to 16--17 feet NAVD88 (providing 4--5 feet of freeboard) as a long-term risk mitigation measure. Additionally, the proposed ground lease and construction agreements should include force majeure provisions that are specifically calibrated for the risk of weather-related construction delays at this coastal site, including tidal flooding, storm surge, and hurricane events.
>
> **6. Environmental Insurance.** Obtain environmental liability insurance, specifically a pollution legal liability (\"PLL\") policy, to cover potential unknown contamination conditions, cost overruns related to remediation, and third-party claims arising from the historical contamination at the Property. Coverage should be tailored to the specific risks identified in this Assessment and should extend for the duration of the remediation and construction period, with consideration of a longer policy term given the long-term nature of the proposed ground lease.
>
> **7. Ongoing Monitoring.** Following completion of remediation activities, implement a post-remediation groundwater monitoring program as may be required by CT DEEP as a condition of the Remedial Action Plan or ELUR compliance. The monitoring program should include periodic sampling of groundwater quality at established monitoring points to confirm that residual contamination is stable and is not migrating toward the Long Island Sound waterfront or adjacent properties.
>
> **8. Bulkhead Assessment.** Commission an independent structural engineering assessment of the existing approximately 480-linear-foot bulkhead along the eastern boundary of the Property to determine the scope and cost of rehabilitation or replacement. The bulkhead is in fair to poor condition based on Halcyon\'s visual observations and represents a material structural and financial consideration for the proposed waterfront development. Bulkhead repair or replacement costs are not included in the environmental remediation cost estimates presented in this report.

**[8. Limitations and Qualifications]{.underline}**

This executive summary is subject to the limitations, qualifications, and assumptions set forth in the full Phase II Environmental Site Assessment report (Halcyon Project No. HEC-2025-0412), which should be reviewed in its entirety for a complete understanding of the investigation methodology, data, findings, and professional opinions presented herein.

The findings and conclusions presented in this report are based on conditions observed and samples collected during the field investigation conducted on April 7--11, 2025. Subsurface conditions are inherently variable and may differ between sampling points and across the Property. The sampling program was designed to provide a reasonable level of characterization of the identified areas of concern, but cannot guarantee that all contamination has been identified or that conditions between borings are identical to those at the sampled locations.

Remediation cost estimates presented in Section 6 are preliminary, opinion-level estimates prepared by Halcyon based on the data available as of the report date. These estimates are intended for planning and due diligence purposes and are subject to change based on actual field conditions encountered during remediation, evolving regulatory requirements, contractor availability and pricing, disposal facility costs, and other market conditions at the time remediation is performed. Halcyon makes no warranty or guarantee that actual remediation costs will not exceed the estimates provided.

This report was prepared for the exclusive use of Meridian Gateway Holdings LLC and its authorized agents, legal counsel, and lenders as specifically identified in Section 1. No other party is authorized to rely on this report or its findings without Halcyon\'s prior written consent, executed by a duly authorized officer of the firm. Any reliance by unauthorized third parties is at their own risk.

This Assessment does not constitute a legal opinion regarding compliance with any federal, state, or local environmental law, regulation, or ordinance. The Client is advised to consult with qualified legal counsel regarding ELUR compliance, regulatory obligations, and the legal implications of the environmental conditions documented in this report for the proposed ground lease transaction and development.

**RESOLUTION NO. 2025-047**

**OF THE BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS** **OF THE CITY OF PORT CALLOWAY REDEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY**

Adopted at a Duly Noticed Special Meeting Held on June 5, 2025

75 Municipal Plaza, Port Calloway, CT 06801

**[PREAMBLE AND ROLL CALL]{.underline}**

A quorum of the Board of Commissioners of the City of Port Calloway Redevelopment Authority (the \"Authority\"), a public body corporate and politic created and existing under Connecticut General Statutes § 8-125, being duly present, the special meeting was called to order by Commissioner Diana Forsythe, Chair. The Chair confirmed that proper notice of the special meeting had been given in accordance with the Connecticut Freedom of Information Act and the Authority\'s bylaws. Howard Koss of Pryor Whitfield & Koss LLP, 55 Courthouse Square, Port Calloway, CT 06801, legal counsel to the Authority, was present and advised the Board throughout the proceedings.

**[RECITALS]{.underline}**

**WHEREAS**, the Authority was established in 2008 under Connecticut General Statutes § 8-125 for the purpose of overseeing the revitalization of Port Calloway\'s 47-acre waterfront district, and the Authority has since that time been engaged in planning, land acquisition, environmental remediation, and developer solicitation activities in furtherance of that mission; and

**WHEREAS**, the Authority holds fee simple title to a 3.2-acre (139,392 square foot) waterfront parcel located at 10-30 Pier Street, Port Calloway, CT 06801, identified as Assessor\'s Parcel No. 127-003-0045 (the \"Parcel\"), situated within the Port Calloway Waterfront Revitalization District, zoned WRD-3 (Mixed-Use High Density), which Parcel was acquired by the Authority through eminent domain proceedings concluded in 2012 and is currently unimproved; and

**WHEREAS**, Meridian Gateway Holdings LLC, a Delaware limited liability company with its principal place of business at 400 Harborview Drive, Suite 1200, Port Calloway, CT 06801 (\"Meridian\" or \"Tenant\"), has proposed to develop a mixed-use project on the Parcel comprising a 28-story residential tower, a 6-story Class A office building, and ground-floor retail space (collectively, the \"Project\"), representing a total project cost of approximately Four Hundred Twenty-Five Million Dollars (\$425,000,000); and

**WHEREAS**, Meridian was formed in 2019 by developer Marcus Ellison, its Managing Member, and institutional partner Coventry Capital Partners LP, a Delaware limited partnership, and Meridian and its principals have developed over \$1.8 billion in mixed-use projects across the Northeast, demonstrating substantial experience and financial capacity relevant to the Project; and

**WHEREAS**, the Authority, through its Executive Director, Paul Castignetti, and with the advice of the Authority\'s legal counsel, Pryor Whitfield & Koss LLP, has negotiated a term sheet dated June 10, 2025 (the \"Term Sheet\") with Meridian setting forth the principal terms and conditions for a long-term ground lease of the Parcel for a term of ninety-nine (99) years, commencing on or about October 1, 2025 (the \"Ground Lease\"), which Term Sheet has been provided to the Board for its review in advance of this meeting; and

**WHEREAS**, the Term Sheet provides for, among other things: (a) an initial annual base rent of Two Million Eight Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars (\$2,850,000) per year, with periodic escalations as set forth therein; (b) percentage rent equal to 2.0% of gross revenues above a Twenty-Eight Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollar (\$28,500,000) annual breakpoint commencing in Year 6 of the Ground Lease term; (c) a security deposit in the form of a Five Million Seven Hundred Thousand Dollar (\$5,700,000) irrevocable standby letter of credit issued by a federally chartered banking institution; (d) a remediation credit of One Million Eight Hundred Thousand Dollars (\$1,800,000) to be applied against initial rent payments in recognition of Tenant\'s assumption of certain environmental remediation responsibilities; and (e) development milestones with reverter rights in favor of the Authority in the event of Tenant\'s failure to achieve such milestones within the prescribed time periods; and

**WHEREAS**, the Authority is aware that the Parcel has recognized environmental conditions resulting from its former use as a ship repair facility (1942--1987), as documented in the Phase I Environmental Site Assessment dated March 15, 2025, and the Phase II Environmental Site Assessment dated May 2, 2025, both prepared by Halcyon Environmental Consultants Inc., and that an Environmental Land Use Restriction (\"ELUR\") was recorded on March 22, 2018, at Volume 412, Page 88 of the Port Calloway Land Records, which restricts certain uses of the Parcel and imposes obligations with respect to the management of residual contamination; and

**WHEREAS**, Meridian has secured a construction loan commitment in the amount of Two Hundred Eighty-Five Million Dollars (\$285,000,000) from Bayside Federal Lending Corp. and equity commitments of Ninety-Five Million Dollars (\$95,000,000) from Coventry Capital Partners LP, and the Ground Lease must contain provisions satisfactory to the construction lender to enable financing of the Project, including customary leasehold mortgage protections and subordination, non-disturbance, and attornment provisions; and

**WHEREAS**, the development of the Parcel is a critical component of the Authority\'s waterfront revitalization initiative and will generate substantial economic benefits to the City of Port Calloway, including the creation of significant construction and permanent employment opportunities, increased tax revenue based on a projected post-development assessed value of One Hundred Seventy-Eight Million Dollars (\$178,000,000), activation of the waterfront promenade and pedestrian access corridors, and the provision of new housing, office, and retail space within the waterfront district; and

**WHEREAS**, consistent with the Authority\'s mission and the restrictive covenant recorded against the Parcel, the Project must include not fewer than fifteen percent (15%) of the residential units as affordable housing units, affordable to households earning at or below eighty percent (80%) of Area Median Income (\"AMI\"), for the duration of the Ground Lease; and

**WHEREAS**, the Project must include a minimum of 8,000 square feet of publicly accessible open space on the waterfront side of the Parcel, connected to the existing public pedestrian promenade, to ensure continued public access to and enjoyment of the waterfront; and

**WHEREAS**, the Authority supports a 15-year tax abatement for the Project, phasing in assessments at 25% of full assessment for Years 1 through 5, 50% of full assessment for Years 6 through 10, and 75% of full assessment for Years 11 through 15, with full assessment thereafter, to be implemented through a separate tax abatement agreement between Meridian and the City of Port Calloway; and

**WHEREAS**, the Authority\'s legal counsel, Pryor Whitfield & Koss LLP, has reviewed the Term Sheet and has advised the Board that the proposed transaction is within the Authority\'s statutory powers under Connecticut General Statutes § 8-125 *et seq.* and is consistent with the Authority\'s adopted waterfront revitalization plan, as most recently amended and readopted in 2022; and

**WHEREAS**, the Board has determined that the Ground Lease serves a valid public purpose by facilitating the redevelopment of a contaminated, underutilized waterfront parcel into a vibrant mixed-use community consistent with the public interest, and that the economic terms of the Ground Lease are fair and reasonable to the Authority and the residents of Port Calloway;

**[OPERATIVE PROVISIONS]{.underline}**

**NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED** by the Board of Commissioners of the City of Port Calloway Redevelopment Authority as follows:

**Section 1. Authorization to Execute Ground Lease.** The Executive Director, Paul Castignetti, is hereby authorized and directed, on behalf of the Authority, to negotiate, execute, and deliver a Ground Lease Agreement with Meridian Gateway Holdings LLC for the Parcel, on terms and conditions substantially consistent with the Term Sheet dated June 10, 2025, for a term of ninety-nine (99) years commencing on or about October 1, 2025, and expiring September 30, 2124, at an initial annual base rent of Two Million Eight Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars (\$2,850,000) per annum, subject to escalation and adjustment as set forth in the Term Sheet, including the percentage rent, remediation credit, and security deposit provisions described therein.

**Section 2. Required Lease Provisions.** The Ground Lease shall include, without limitation, the following provisions:

> \(a\) development milestones, including commencement and completion deadlines for each phase of the Project, with reverter rights in favor of the Authority in the event of Tenant\'s failure to achieve such milestones within the prescribed time periods;
>
> \(b\) a requirement that not fewer than fifteen percent (15%) of the residential units in the Project be designated as affordable housing units for households earning at or below eighty percent (80%) of Area Median Income for the duration of the Ground Lease;
>
> \(c\) insurance requirements satisfactory to the Authority, including commercial general liability, property, builder\'s risk, and such other coverages as the Authority may reasonably require;
>
> \(d\) compliance with the Environmental Land Use Restriction recorded at Volume 412, Page 88 of the Port Calloway Land Records, including any obligations relating to the management, monitoring, and reporting of residual environmental contamination on the Parcel;
>
> \(e\) a minimum of 8,000 square feet of publicly accessible open space on the waterfront side of the Parcel, connected to the existing public pedestrian promenade, with maintenance obligations to be borne by Tenant;
>
> \(f\) provisions requiring the Project to comply with all applicable zoning, building, environmental, and other governmental requirements; and
>
> \(g\) such other terms, conditions, and provisions as the Executive Director, in consultation with the Authority\'s legal counsel, deems necessary or appropriate to protect the interests of the Authority and to effectuate the purposes of this Resolution.

**Section 3. Authorization of Related Documents.** The Executive Director is further authorized and directed to execute and deliver, on behalf of the Authority, such other documents and instruments as may be necessary or appropriate to consummate the transaction contemplated by this Resolution, including, without limitation:

> \(a\) a Subordination, Non-Disturbance, and Attornment Agreement with Bayside Federal Lending Corp. or any other leasehold mortgagee approved by the Authority in accordance with the terms of the Ground Lease;
>
> \(b\) a memorandum of lease in recordable form for filing in the Port Calloway Land Records;
>
> \(c\) estoppel certificates as may be reasonably requested by Meridian or its lenders from time to time during the term of the Ground Lease; and
>
> \(d\) any tax abatement agreement with the City of Port Calloway on terms consistent with the phased assessment structure described in the recitals hereto.

**Section 4. Delegation of Authority.** The Executive Director is authorized to approve such changes, modifications, and amendments to the terms and conditions of the Ground Lease and the related documents as the Executive Director, in consultation with the Authority\'s legal counsel, determines to be immaterial or otherwise in the best interest of the Authority; *provided, however*, that:

> \(a\) the initial annual base rent shall not be reduced below Two Million Eight Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars (\$2,850,000);
>
> \(b\) the lease term shall not exceed ninety-nine (99) years;
>
> \(c\) the affordable housing requirement of not fewer than fifteen percent (15%) of the residential units at or below eighty percent (80%) of Area Median Income shall not be reduced or eliminated; and
>
> \(d\) any deviation from the Term Sheet that the Executive Director or the Authority\'s legal counsel determines to be material shall be brought before the Board for further review and approval prior to execution.

**Section 5. Effective Date.** This Resolution shall take effect immediately upon its adoption.

**[CERTIFICATION]{.underline}**

I hereby certify that the foregoing Resolution No. 2025-047 was duly adopted by the Board of Commissioners of the City of Port Calloway Redevelopment Authority at a special meeting duly noticed and held on June 5, 2025, at which a quorum was present and acting throughout, by a vote of **\_\_ in favor, \_** *opposed, and* **\_**\_\_ abstaining, and that said Resolution has not been amended, modified, or rescinded since its adoption and is in full force and effect as of the date set forth below.

import re
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor, Emu
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_LINE_SPACING, WD_BREAK
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_SECTION
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

FONT = "Times New Roman"

def new_doc(margin_l=1.0, margin_r=1.0):
    doc = Document()
    st = doc.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = FONT
    st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), FONT)
    pf = st.paragraph_format
    pf.space_before = Pt(0); pf.space_after = Pt(6)
    pf.line_spacing_rule = WD_LINE_SPACING.SINGLE
    s = doc.sections[0]
    s.page_width = Inches(8.5); s.page_height = Inches(11)
    s.left_margin = Inches(margin_l); s.right_margin = Inches(margin_r)
    s.top_margin = Inches(1.0); s.bottom_margin = Inches(0.9)
    return doc

def _runs(par, text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None, caps=False, color=None, underline=False):
    """Render text, honouring **bold** and _italic_ inline markers."""
    tokens = re.split(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*|__.+?__)", text)
    for t in tokens:
        if not t: continue
        b, i = bold, italic
        if t.startswith("**") and t.endswith("**") and len(t) > 4:
            t = t[2:-2]; b = True
        elif t.startswith("__") and t.endswith("__") and len(t) > 4:
            t = t[2:-2]; i = True
        r = par.add_run(t)
        r.bold = b; r.italic = i
        r.font.name = FONT
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if caps: r.font.all_caps = True
        if underline: r.underline = True
        if color: r.font.color.rgb = color
    return par

def cover_line(doc, text, size=10, bold=False, space_after=6, center=True, italic=False, caps=False, color=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    if center: p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    _runs(p, text, bold=bold, italic=italic, size=size, caps=caps, color=color)
    return p

def art(doc, text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    pf = p.paragraph_format
    pf.space_before = Pt(16); pf.space_after = Pt(10); pf.keep_with_next = True
    r = p.add_run(text.upper()); r.bold = True; r.font.name = FONT; r.font.size = Pt(11)
    return p

def sec(doc, num, heading, body=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    pf = p.paragraph_format
    pf.left_indent = Inches(0.5); pf.first_line_indent = Inches(-0.5)
    pf.space_before = Pt(8); pf.space_after = Pt(6); pf.keep_with_next = bool(body is None)
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    _runs(p, num + ".\t", bold=True)
    tab_stops = p.paragraph_format.tab_stops
    tab_stops.add_tab_stop(Inches(0.5))
    if heading:
        _runs(p, heading + ". ", bold=True)
    if body:
        _runs(p, body)
    return p

def sub(doc, label, body, level=1):
    ind = {1: 1.0, 2: 1.5, 3: 2.0}[level]
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    pf = p.paragraph_format
    pf.left_indent = Inches(ind); pf.first_line_indent = Inches(-0.5)
    pf.space_before = Pt(0); pf.space_after = Pt(5)
    pf.tab_stops.add_tab_stop(Inches(ind))
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    _runs(p, label + "\t")
    _runs(p, body)
    return p

def para(doc, text, indent=0.0, first=0.0, space_after=6, align="justify", size=None, bold=False, italic=False):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    pf = p.paragraph_format
    pf.left_indent = Inches(indent); pf.first_line_indent = Inches(first)
    pf.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY if align == "justify" else WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    _runs(p, text, bold=bold, italic=italic, size=size)
    return p

def defn(doc, term, text):
    return para(doc, '**"%s"** %s' % (term, text), first=0.5, space_after=5)

def note(doc, text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    pf = p.paragraph_format
    pf.left_indent = Inches(0.5); pf.right_indent = Inches(0.5)
    pf.space_before = Pt(4); pf.space_after = Pt(8)
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    _runs(p, text, italic=True, size=9)
    return p

def shade(cell, hexcolor="D9D9D9"):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def table(doc, rows, widths, header=True, size=9, align_right=None, caption=None, bold_rows=()):
    if caption:
        p = doc.add_paragraph(); p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(6); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
        p.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True
        _runs(p, caption, bold=True, size=9)
    t = doc.add_table(rows=len(rows), cols=len(rows[0]))
    t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit = False
    align_right = align_right or []
    for ri, row in enumerate(rows):
        for ci, val in enumerate(row):
            cell = t.cell(ri, ci)
            cell.width = Inches(widths[ci])
            cell.text = ""
            p = cell.paragraphs[0]
            p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(1); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
            p.paragraph_format.line_spacing_rule = WD_LINE_SPACING.SINGLE
            if ci in align_right and ri > 0:
                p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
            elif ci > 0:
                p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
            _runs(p, str(val), bold=(header and ri == 0) or (ri in bold_rows), size=size)
            if header and ri == 0:
                shade(cell, "D9D9D9")
    for row in t.rows:
        for cell in row.cells:
            cell.width = Inches(widths[row.cells.index(cell)] if False else 0)
    # reapply widths properly
    for ri, row in enumerate(t.rows):
        for ci, cell in enumerate(row.cells):
            cell.width = Inches(widths[ci])
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def pagebreak(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.add_run().add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def field(par, instr):
    r = par.add_run()
    f1 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f1.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "begin")
    it = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); it.set(qn("xml:space"), "preserve"); it.text = instr
    f2 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f2.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "separate")
    t = OxmlElement("w:t"); t.text = "1"
    f3 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f3.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "end")
    r._r.append(f1); r._r.append(it); r._r.append(f2); r._r.append(t); r._r.append(f3)

def header_footer(doc, left_text, right_text="", footer_left=""):
    s = doc.sections[0]
    hp = s.header.paragraphs[0]
    hp.text = ""
    hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
    _runs(hp, left_text, size=8, italic=True)
    # bottom border on header paragraph
    pPr = hp._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    pbdr = OxmlElement("w:pBdr"); bottom = OxmlElement("w:bottom")
    bottom.set(qn("w:val"), "single"); bottom.set(qn("w:sz"), "4"); bottom.set(qn("w:space"), "1"); bottom.set(qn("w:color"), "808080")
    pbdr.append(bottom); pPr.append(pbdr)
    fp = s.footer.paragraphs[0]
    fp.text = ""
    fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if footer_left:
        _runs(fp, footer_left + "    |    ", size=8, italic=True)
    _runs(fp, "Page ", size=8)
    field(fp, "PAGE")
    _runs(fp, " of ", size=8)
    field(fp, "NUMPAGES")

def set_core(doc, title, subject, author, comments):
    cp = doc.core_properties
    cp.title = title; cp.subject = subject; cp.author = author
    cp.comments = comments; cp.category = "Ground Lease"
PYEOF

def table(doc, rows, widths, header=True, size=9, align_right=None, caption=None, bold_rows=()):
    if caption:
        p = doc.add_paragraph(); p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(6); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
        p.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True
        _runs(p, caption, bold=True, size=9)
    t = doc.add_table(rows=len(rows), cols=len(rows[0]))
    t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit = False
    align_right = align_right or []
    for ri, row in enumerate(rows):
        for ci, val in enumerate(row):
            cell = t.cell(ri, ci)
            cell.width = Inches(widths[ci])
            cell.text = ""
            p = cell.paragraphs[0]
            p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(1); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
            p.paragraph_format.line_spacing_rule = WD_LINE_SPACING.SINGLE
            if ci in align_right and ri > 0:
                p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
            elif ci > 0:
                p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
            _runs(p, str(val), bold=(header and ri == 0) or (ri in bold_rows), size=size)
            if header and ri == 0:
                shade(cell, "D9D9D9")
    for row in t.rows:
        for cell in row.cells:
            cell.width = Inches(widths[row.cells.index(cell)] if False else 0)
    # reapply widths properly
    for ri, row in enumerate(t.rows):
        for ci, cell in enumerate(row.cells):
            cell.width = Inches(widths[ci])
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

    t = OxmlElement("w:t"); t.text = "1"

    r._r.append(f1); r._r.append(it); r._r.append(f2); r._r.append(t); r._r.append(f3)

from helpers import *

def blocks(doc):
    pagebreak(doc)
    art(doc, "Article 8. Security Deposit and Letter of Credit")
    sec(doc, "8.1", "Security Deposit", "On or before the Lease Commencement Date, Tenant shall deliver to Landlord a "
        "security deposit in the amount of **Five Million Seven Hundred Thousand Dollars ($5,700,000)**, equal to "
        "twenty-four (24) monthly installments of the initial Base Rent ($237,500 × 24), as security for the "
        "performance of Tenant's obligations under this Lease. The Security Deposit is not an advance payment of Rent, "
        "is not a measure or liquidation of Landlord's damages, and shall not be commingled with Landlord's other "
        "funds.")
    sec(doc, "8.2", "Form", "The Security Deposit shall be provided, at Tenant's election, in the form of (a) an "
        "irrevocable standby letter of credit substantially in the form attached as **Exhibit E**, naming Landlord as "
        "beneficiary, drawable in Connecticut or by facsimile or electronic presentation, and permitting partial draws "
        "and multiple draws and reinstatements (the \"**Letter of Credit**\"); or (b) cash deposited with an escrow "
        "agent reasonably acceptable to Landlord and each Leasehold Mortgagee. Tenant's election under this Section "
        "8.2 shall be made no later than thirty (30) days prior to the Lease Commencement Date.")
    sec(doc, "8.3", "Issuer Requirements", "Any Letter of Credit shall be issued by a commercial bank organized under "
        "the laws of the United States or any state thereof that (a) has a long-term issuer credit rating of not less "
        "than A- from Standard & Poor's Ratings Services or A3 from Moody's Investors Service, Inc. (or an equivalent "
        "rating from a nationally recognized rating agency), or (b) is a federally chartered banking institution with "
        "capital and surplus of not less than $[●]. If the rating of the issuing bank falls below the required level, "
        "Tenant shall deliver a replacement Letter of Credit from a qualifying issuer within sixty (60) days after "
        "written notice from Landlord, and such failure shall not constitute an Event of Default until the expiration "
        "of such sixty (60) day period.")
    sec(doc, "8.4", "Reduction of the Security Deposit", "The Security Deposit shall be reduced to **Two Million Eight "
        "Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($2,850,000)** upon Tenant's demonstration, to Landlord's reasonable "
        "satisfaction, that the Project has achieved and maintained an Occupancy Rate of ninety percent (90%) or "
        "greater for twenty-four (24) consecutive full calendar months (the \"**Reduction Threshold**\"). The "
        "following procedures and definitions shall govern:")
    sub(doc, "(a)", "**Occupancy Rate** means, as of any date, the quotient (expressed as a percentage) obtained by "
        "dividing (i) the aggregate rentable square footage of all residential, office and retail space in the Project "
        "that is subject to a bona fide lease or occupancy agreement under which rent is being paid or a free-rent "
        "period is in effect, by (ii) the aggregate rentable square footage of all residential, office and retail "
        "space in the completed portions of the Project, in each case measured on a consistent basis. Residential "
        "square footage shall be the net rentable area of the dwelling units, exclusive of common areas and corridors. "
        "A Project that is not fully constructed shall be tested only with respect to completed buildings for which a "
        "Certificate of Occupancy has been issued.")
    sub(doc, "(b)", "**Demonstration.** Tenant shall deliver to Landlord (i) a certified rent roll as of the last day "
        "of the twentieth-fourth consecutive month, (ii) a certificate of an authorized financial officer of Tenant "
        "certifying the Occupancy Rate calculation, and (iii) such supporting documentation as Landlord may reasonably "
        "request. Landlord shall respond within thirty (30) days after receipt; failure to object in writing within "
        "such period shall constitute approval.")
    sub(doc, "(c)", "**Implementation.** Within ten (10) Business Days after Tenant's satisfaction of the Reduction "
        "Threshold, Landlord shall execute and deliver such instruments (including an amendment to the Letter of "
        "Credit) as are necessary to effect the reduction, and shall return any excess cash Security Deposit. Tenant "
        "may deliver a replacement Letter of Credit in the reduced amount in lieu of an amendment.")
    sub(doc, "(d)", "**No reinstatement.** The reduced Security Deposit shall not be increased by reason of any "
        "subsequent decline in occupancy, and the reduced amount shall remain the Security Deposit for the balance of "
        "the Term, subject only to Section 8.6 (replenishment following a draw).")
    sec(doc, "8.5", "Draws", "Landlord may draw upon the Letter of Credit (or apply the cash Security Deposit) only "
        "(a) after the occurrence of an Event of Default that remains uncured after the expiration of all applicable "
        "notice and cure periods (including the Lender Cure Periods under Section 9.5), and (b) only to the extent of "
        "amounts then due and payable and unpaid, or Documented Damages finally determined as provided in Section 10.7. "
        "Landlord may not draw on account of any amount that Tenant disputes in good faith while the dispute is "
        "pending under Section 20.2, and may not draw the entire Security Deposit as a consequence of any single "
        "Event of Default except to the extent of amounts finally determined. Landlord shall give simultaneous written "
        "notice of any draw to each Leasehold Mortgagee. Any amount drawn shall be applied to Tenant's obligations "
        "under this Lease and not to any other purpose.")
    sec(doc, "8.6", "Replenishment", "If Landlord lawfully draws upon the Security Deposit, Tenant shall, within thirty "
        "(30) days after written demand (accompanied by a written statement of the amount drawn and its application), "
        "restore the Security Deposit to the required amount. Tenant's failure to do so within such period, if "
        "continuing for ten (10) Business Days after a second written notice, shall constitute an Event of Default.")
    sec(doc, "8.7", "Transfer; Return", "Landlord may transfer the Security Deposit to any successor owner of "
        "Landlord's interest in the Premises, and upon such transfer and written notice to Tenant and each Leasehold "
        "Mortgagee, Landlord shall be released from further liability with respect thereto. Within thirty (30) days "
        "after the later of the Expiration Date (or earlier Termination Date) and the satisfaction of all of Tenant's "
        "obligations, Landlord shall return the Security Deposit to Tenant, together with any interest accrued on a "
        "cash deposit.")
    sec(doc, "8.8", "Renewal; Expiration", "If the Letter of Credit has a stated expiration date, Tenant shall deliver "
        "a renewal or replacement not later than thirty (30) days prior to its expiration, or shall cause the Letter "
        "of Credit to be an evergreen letter of credit that automatically renews for successive one-year periods "
        "unless the issuer gives not less than sixty (60) days' prior written notice of non-renewal. Failure to "
        "deliver a renewal or replacement shall constitute an Event of Default only if such failure continues for ten "
        "(10) Business Days after written notice from Landlord and any Leasehold Mortgagee.")
    sec(doc, "8.9", "No Landlord Lien; No Waiver", "Tenant's delivery of the Security Deposit shall not create any "
        "lien or security interest in favor of Landlord in any property of Tenant other than the Security Deposit, and "
        "Landlord hereby waives any statutory or contractual landlord's lien, distraint or right of levy against "
        "Tenant's personal property or the Improvements.")

    # ================= ARTICLE 9 =================
    pagebreak(doc)
    art(doc, "Article 9. Leasehold Financing; Lender Protections; SNDA; New Lease")
    para(doc, "The provisions of this Article 9 are material inducements to Tenant's execution of this Lease and to "
              "the closing of the construction financing for the Project. The parties acknowledge that the "
              "requirements of this Article 9 equal or exceed the ground lease requirements of the Construction Lender "
              "and are intended to satisfy the requirements of any institutional lender that may hold a Leasehold "
              "Mortgage at any time during the Term. Each Leasehold Mortgagee is an express third-party beneficiary of "
              "this Article 9 and of Sections 10.5, 10.6 and 10.7, and may enforce those provisions directly.")
    sec(doc, "9.1", "Right to Encumber", "Tenant may, at any time and from time to time, without the consent, "
        "approval or joinder of Landlord and without the payment of any consent fee, administrative charge or other "
        "compensation to Landlord: (a) grant one or more Leasehold Mortgages encumbering all or any portion of "
        "Tenant's leasehold interest in the Premises and the Improvements; (b) collaterally assign this Lease, all "
        "subleases, leases, rents, revenues, permits, contracts and plans; (c) pledge the direct and indirect "
        "ownership interests in Tenant; and (d) grant such other security as any lender may require. No consent, "
        "approval or other condition of Landlord shall be required for the granting, recording, enforcement, "
        "refinancing or foreclosure of any Leasehold Mortgage. Each Leasehold Mortgage shall be permitted to encumber "
        "the entire leasehold estate created by this Lease, together with all Improvements, fixtures and "
        "appurtenances now or hereafter located on the Premises.")
    sec(doc, "9.2", "Designation of Leasehold Mortgagees", "Tenant may designate one or more Leasehold Mortgagees "
        "under this Lease. Each Leasehold Mortgagee shall deliver to Landlord a written notice specifying its name, "
        "address for notices, the amount of its loan and the collateral securing it, and may update such information "
        "from time to time. Landlord shall recognize each Leasehold Mortgagee so designated. There is no limit on the "
        "number of Leasehold Mortgagees, nor on the number of refinancings, restructurings or recapitalizations of "
        "the leasehold financing during the Term.")
    sec(doc, "9.3", "Notices to Leasehold Mortgagees", "Landlord shall deliver to each Leasehold Mortgagee, "
        "simultaneously with delivery to Tenant (and in any event no later than the delivery to Tenant), a copy of "
        "every notice of default, notice of termination, notice of Milestone Default, notice of intended termination "
        "or non-renewal, notice of casualty or condemnation, notice of any proceeding affecting the Premises, and every "
        "other notice, consent, approval, statement, estoppel or instrument delivered to Tenant under this Lease. "
        "Notices to each Leasehold Mortgagee shall be delivered to the address designated under Section 9.2 and to "
        "its counsel as designated. Any notice of default or termination not delivered to each Leasehold Mortgagee in "
        "accordance with this Section 9.3 shall be void and of no effect.")
    sec(doc, "9.4", "No Surrender, Amendment or Termination Without Mortgagee Consent", "For so long as any Leasehold "
        "Mortgage remains in effect, Landlord shall not accept a voluntary surrender or cancellation of this Lease, and "
        "Landlord and Tenant shall not amend, modify, supplement or terminate this Lease in any material respect, "
        "without the prior written consent of each Leasehold Mortgagee. Any purported surrender, amendment, "
        "modification, supplement or termination effected without such consent shall be void and of no force or effect "
        "as against each Leasehold Mortgagee, and this Lease shall continue in full force and effect as if such "
        "purported surrender, amendment, modification, supplement or termination had not occurred.")
    sec(doc, "9.5", "Lender Cure Periods", "No termination of this Lease and no exercise of any remedy by Landlord "
        "that would extinguish or impair any Leasehold Mortgage shall be effective unless and until Landlord has "
        "delivered the required notices to each Leasehold Mortgagee and the following cure periods (each, a "
        "\"**Lender Cure Period**\") have expired without cure:")
    sub(doc, "(a)", "**Monetary Defaults.** Sixty (60) days from the date of the Leasehold Mortgagee's receipt of "
        "notice of the monetary default to cure the default on behalf of Tenant.")
    sub(doc, "(b)", "**Non-Monetary Defaults.** Ninety (90) days from the date of the Leasehold Mortgagee's receipt of "
        "notice of the non-monetary default to cure the default, or, if such cure cannot reasonably be completed "
        "within ninety (90) days, to commence cure within such ninety (90) day period and thereafter diligently and "
        "continuously prosecute such cure to completion.")
    sub(doc, "(c)", "**Milestone Defaults.** One hundred eighty (180) days commencing upon the expiration of the "
        "Milestone Cure Period, during which the Leasehold Mortgagee may cure the Milestone Default, including by "
        "(i) causing the applicable Milestone to be achieved, (ii) advancing funds to Tenant or to a replacement "
        "developer to achieve the Milestone, (iii) installing a replacement developer, general contractor or property "
        "manager reasonably acceptable under Section 9.7, or (iv) causing Tenant's interest under this Lease to be "
        "transferred to the Leasehold Mortgagee or its designee in accordance with Section 9.7.")
    para(doc, "Each Lender Cure Period shall run in addition to, and not concurrently with, any cure period afforded to "
              "Tenant, and Landlord shall accept performance by a Leasehold Mortgagee with the same effect as "
              "performance by Tenant. A Leasehold Mortgagee may cure any default without curing all defaults and "
              "without being deemed to have assumed any of Tenant's obligations. Landlord shall give each Leasehold "
              "Mortgagee written notice of the commencement and expiration of each Lender Cure Period.")
    sec(doc, "9.6", "New Lease", "If this Lease is terminated for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation "
        "a Milestone Default, any other Event of Default by Tenant, surrender, rejection in bankruptcy, or operation of "
        "law (each, a \"**Termination Event**\"), then each Leasehold Mortgagee (or its designee) shall have the "
        "right, upon written request delivered to Landlord within sixty (60) days after such Leasehold Mortgagee's "
        "receipt of notice of the Termination Event, to enter into a new ground lease of the Premises with Landlord "
        "(a \"**New Lease**\") on the following terms:")
    sub(doc, "(a)", "**Term.** The New Lease shall be for the remainder of the Term of this Lease (as if this Lease had "
        "not been terminated), without reduction, together with any extension right then available under Section 2.7.")
    sub(doc, "(b)", "**Terms.** The New Lease shall be on the same terms and conditions as this Lease, modified only "
        "to the extent necessary to (i) reflect the identity of the new tenant, (ii) delete provisions that are "
        "inapplicable because the applicable default has been cured, (iii) state that the New Lease is effective as "
        "of the Termination Date, (iv) provide that the Leasehold Mortgagee (or its designee) assumes Tenant's "
        "obligations prospectively from the effective date of the New Lease and is not liable for any obligation, "
        "liability or default of Tenant arising before such date (other than the cure obligations described below), "
        "and (v) eliminate any improvement-forfeiture, reverter or security deposit forfeiture provisions.")
    sub(doc, "(c)", "**Cure.** The Leasehold Mortgagee (or its designee) shall cure all monetary defaults existing "
        "under this Lease within sixty (60) days after the effective date of the New Lease, and all non-monetary "
        "defaults reasonably susceptible of cure within ninety (90) days after the effective date of the New Lease, "
        "or, if any such non-monetary default cannot reasonably be cured within such period, shall commence cure "
        "within ninety (90) days and thereafter diligently and continuously pursue cure to completion, but in no "
        "event later than one hundred eighty (180) days after the effective date of the New Lease.")
    sub(doc, "(d)", "**Execution.** Landlord shall execute, acknowledge, deliver and record the New Lease within thirty "
        "(30) days after the Leasehold Mortgagee's written request, and the New Lease shall be effective as of the "
        "Termination Date. Landlord shall not require any consent, fee, payment, guaranty, credit support or other "
        "condition in connection with the New Lease, other than the cure obligations in Section 9.6(c).")
    sub(doc, "(e)", "**Priority and Subleases.** The New Lease shall have a priority in all respects equal to the "
        "priority of this Lease, and all subleases, licenses and occupancy agreements entered into by Tenant or any "
        "subtenant before the Termination Event shall be recognized by Landlord under the New Lease, and Landlord "
        "shall take the Premises subject thereto.")
    sub(doc, "(f)", "**No ROFR.** Neither Landlord's right of first refusal under Section 11.5 nor any consent, notice "
        "or other requirement of Article 11 shall apply to the New Lease or to any assignment by a Leasehold "
        "Mortgagee in connection with the exercise of its rights under this Article 9.")
    sub(doc, "(g)", "**Pre-Authorization; Enforceability.** Landlord covenants that it shall include in the resolution "
        "approving this Lease an express authorization of its obligation to execute and deliver a New Lease in "
        "accordance with this Section 9.6 and of its obligation to pay the Improvement Payment under Section 10.6, and "
        "that no further action of its Board of Commissioners shall be required to permit or give effect to either "
        "obligation. Landlord acknowledges that each Leasehold Mortgagee is relying on this Section 9.6 in making its "
        "loan, and that the Leasehold Mortgagee shall be entitled to specific performance of this Section 9.6 and to "
        "damages for its breach.")
    sub(doc, "(h)", "**Effect on Seniority of Landlord's Fee.** Nothing in this Section 9.6 shall subordinate "
        "Landlord's fee interest in the land, but Landlord's fee interest shall in all events remain subject to the "
        "New Lease.")
    sec(doc, "9.7", "Foreclosure and Assignment", "Each Leasehold Mortgagee shall have the unconditional right to "
        "foreclose on the leasehold interest (whether by judicial foreclosure, power of sale, strict foreclosure, or "
        "otherwise) or to accept a deed or assignment in lieu of foreclosure, and to assign this Lease to a qualified "
        "transferee at or following any foreclosure sale or deed-in-lieu transfer, without the prior consent of "
        "Landlord and without triggering the ROFR under Section 11.5 or any other right of Landlord. A transferee "
        "shall be deemed qualified if it (a) is a Person with not less than [**Tenant position:** $[●] of net worth] or "
        "assets under management, (b) has demonstrable experience in owning and operating comparable mixed-use "
        "properties or waterfront development, or (c) is a Leasehold Mortgagee or an affiliate or designee thereof or "
        "any institutional investor, pension fund, real estate investment trust, insurance company, bank or "
        "opportunity fund or an affiliate of any of them. Landlord shall not unreasonably withhold, condition or delay "
        "recognition of any such transferee as Tenant, shall execute and deliver any estoppel, recognition "
        "agreement, SNDA or other document reasonably requested by a Leasehold Mortgagee within ten (10) Business "
        "Days, and shall not charge any fee in connection therewith.")
    sec(doc, "9.8", "Bankruptcy Protections", "If Tenant becomes a debtor in any proceeding under Title 11 of the "
        "United States Code or any similar state insolvency law:")
    sub(doc, "(a)", "this Lease shall not terminate, and Landlord shall have no right to terminate this Lease or to "
        "exercise any remedy, solely by reason of the commencement of such proceeding (and any provision of this Lease "
        "purporting to terminate this Lease upon such a filing shall be void to the extent unenforceable under 11 "
        "U.S.C. § 365(e));")
    sub(doc, "(b)", "each Leasehold Mortgagee shall have the right to request that any trustee, debtor-in-possession "
        "or other party in interest assume or reject this Lease in a timely manner consistent with 11 U.S.C. § 365, "
        "and to cure any defaults and provide adequate assurance of future performance on behalf of Tenant to the "
        "extent necessary to prevent rejection;")
    sub(doc, "(c)", "Tenant and any trustee shall not reject this Lease without the prior written consent of each "
        "Leasehold Mortgagee, and Landlord shall not oppose any election by any Leasehold Mortgagee under 11 U.S.C. "
        "§ 365(h) or the counterpart provisions applicable to the leasehold mortgagee; and")
    sub(doc, "(d)", "the New Lease right under Section 9.6 shall survive any rejection of this Lease in bankruptcy to "
        "the fullest extent permitted by Applicable Law, and Landlord shall recognize each Leasehold Mortgagee's "
        "right to obtain a New Lease notwithstanding such rejection. The parties acknowledge that the New Lease right "
        "is intended to be a property interest of each Leasehold Mortgagee enforceable notwithstanding 11 U.S.C. "
        "§ 365(h) and § 365(i).")
    sec(doc, "9.9", "SNDA", "Landlord shall, simultaneously with or prior to the first advance of any loan secured by a "
        "Leasehold Mortgage, and at any later time upon the request of any Leasehold Mortgagee, execute, acknowledge, "
        "deliver and record an SNDA containing not less than the terms set forth on **Exhibit F**, including (a) "
        "Landlord's acknowledgment of the existence and priority of the Leasehold Mortgage; (b) Landlord's agreement "
        "not to disturb the Leasehold Mortgagee's security interest or the rights of any purchaser at foreclosure or "
        "transferee by deed in lieu of foreclosure; (c) Landlord's agreement to recognize the Leasehold Mortgagee or "
        "its designee or purchaser as Tenant under this Lease or the New Lease; and (d) provisions relating to "
        "casualty, condemnation, insurance and condemnation proceeds. Landlord shall have no obligation to subordinate "
        "its fee interest in the land, and nothing in any SNDA shall be construed to do so. Landlord's failure to "
        "deliver an SNDA within ten (10) Business Days after request shall constitute a Landlord Event of Default "
        "curable only by delivery, and Tenant may obtain specific performance.")
    sec(doc, "9.10", "Refinancing and Recapitalization Cooperation", "Landlord shall, without charge, within ten (10) "
        "Business Days after request, execute, acknowledge and deliver such estoppel certificates, consents, "
        "recognition agreements, SNDAs, subordination and non-disturbance agreements, financing statements, "
        "memoranda, and other instruments as Tenant or any Leasehold Mortgagee or prospective lender may reasonably "
        "request in connection with any financing, refinancing, securitization, syndication or recapitalization during "
        "the Term, in each case in form reasonably satisfactory to Landlord and consistent with this Lease. Landlord's "
        "obligations under this Section 9.10 shall not be limited in number of transactions.")
    sec(doc, "9.11", "Landlord's Fee Interest", "Landlord shall not mortgage, pledge, encumber, sell or otherwise "
        "transfer its fee interest in the land during the Term without (a) delivering to Tenant and each Leasehold "
        "Mortgagee a subordination, non-disturbance and attornment agreement from the transferee or lender, in form "
        "reasonably satisfactory to Tenant and each Leasehold Mortgagee, providing that this Lease and the New Lease "
        "right shall not be disturbed, and (b) giving Tenant not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice. Any "
        "transfer of Landlord's fee interest shall be subject to this Lease in all respects.")

    # ================= ARTICLE 10 =================
    pagebreak(doc)
    art(doc, "Article 10. Defaults, Remedies and Milestone Termination")
    sec(doc, "10.1", "Tenant Events of Default", "Each of the following shall constitute an Event of Default by "
        "Tenant, subject in each case to the notice and cure provisions of Article 9 and this Article 10:")
    t_ev = [

        "fifteen (15) days after written notice from Landlord;",
        "(c) Tenant's failure to perform or observe any material non-monetary obligation under this Lease within "
        "thirty (30) days after written notice specifying the failure, or, if the failure cannot reasonably be cured "
        "within thirty (30) days, Tenant's failure to commence cure within such period and thereafter diligently "

              "of Default under Section 10.1(a) or (b) more than twice in any period of twelve (12) consecutive months "

    sec(doc, "10.2", "Landlord Events of Default", "Each of the following shall constitute an Event of Default by "

        "Leasehold Mortgagee):")
    l_ev = [
        "(a) Landlord's failure to pay any amount due to Tenant under this Lease within ten (10) Business Days after "

        "(c) Landlord's failure to deliver any SNDA, estoppel certificate, consent, approval, New Lease or other "

    for t in l_ev: sub(doc, t.split(")")[0] + ")", t.split(")", 1)[1].strip())
    sec(doc, "10.3", "Landlord's Remedies", "Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default by "
        "Tenant, Landlord may, subject in all respects to Article 9 and Section 10.5:")
    sub(doc, "(a)", "terminate this Lease by written notice, but only after the expiration of all applicable notice and "
        "cure periods, including the Milestone Cure Period and each Lender Cure Period;")
    sub(doc, "(b)", "draw upon the Security Deposit only to the extent permitted by Section 8.5;")
    sub(doc, "(c)", "recover from Tenant, as damages (and not as a penalty), an amount equal to the Documented Damages "
        "determined under Section 10.7;")
    sub(doc, "(d)", "if the Event of Default is a Milestone Default, exercise the remedy set forth in Sections 10.5 and "
        "10.6, which shall be Landlord's sole and exclusive remedy for a Milestone Default; and")
    sub(doc, "(e)", "pursue specific performance of Tenant's obligations (other than an obligation to expend money) "

    para(doc, "Landlord shall have **no** right to declare the entire balance of future Rent immediately due and "

              "Landlord's remedies are cumulative except that, as to a Milestone Default, Sections 10.5 and 10.6 are "
              "the sole and exclusive remedy of Landlord.")
    sec(doc, "10.4", "Tenant's Remedies", "Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default by "
        "Landlord, Tenant may: (a) cure the default on Landlord's behalf and set off the reasonable cost thereof, "
        "together with interest at the Default Interest Rate, against Rent as provided in Section 4.6; (b) seek "
        "specific performance of Landlord's obligations, including the obligation to execute a New Lease, an SNDA or "
        "an estoppel, and the parties agree that the remedy of specific performance shall be available notwithstanding "
        "that damages may be an adequate remedy; (c) recover actual direct damages; (d) suspend performance of "
        "Tenant's obligations under this Lease to the extent caused by Landlord's default; and (e) terminate this "
        "Lease upon sixty (60) days' written notice if a Landlord Event of Default remains uncured and renders the "
        "Premises unusable for the Permitted Uses, in which case Tenant shall be entitled to the Improvement Payment "
        "determined under Section 10.6 as if the Termination Date were a termination under Section 10.5.")
    sec(doc, "10.5", "Milestone Default; Termination Procedure",
        "The following procedure shall apply to any Milestone Default, and shall supersede and control over any "
        "provision of this Lease or the Term Sheet that would cause this Lease to terminate automatically:")
    sub(doc, "(a)", "**Milestone Notice.** Landlord may deliver to Tenant (and simultaneously to each Leasehold "
        "Mortgagee) a written notice specifying the Milestone Default, the Milestone and Milestone Deadline "
        "asserted, the factual basis for the assertion, and Landlord's calculation of any extensions under Section "
        "3.4. A notice that does not satisfy these requirements shall be ineffective.")
    sub(doc, "(b)", "**Tenant Cure.** Tenant shall have one hundred eighty (180) calendar days following its receipt "
        "of a valid Milestone Notice to cure the Milestone Default by achieving the applicable Milestone (the "
        "\"**Milestone Cure Period**\").")
    sub(doc, "(c)", "**Extension of Cure Period.** The Milestone Cure Period shall be extended by any period during "
        "which Tenant is prevented from achieving the applicable Milestone by a Force Majeure Event, a permitting "
        "delay, Landlord Delay or the exercise by a Leasehold Mortgagee of its rights under Section 9.5.")
    sub(doc, "(d)", "**Lender Cure Period.** Following the expiration of the Milestone Cure Period, each Leasehold "
        "Mortgagee shall have the Lender Cure Period described in Section 9.5(c).")
    sub(doc, "(e)", "**Election.** If the Milestone Default remains uncured upon the expiration of all of the "
        "foregoing periods, Landlord may elect to terminate this Lease only by written notice delivered to Tenant and "
        "each Leasehold Mortgagee within thirty (30) days after the expiration of the last such period. If Landlord "
        "does not so elect within such thirty (30) day period, Landlord shall be deemed to have waived that Milestone "
        "Default, and Landlord may not thereafter terminate this Lease or exercise any other remedy on account of it.")
    sub(doc, "(f)", "**No Automatic Termination.** This Lease shall **not** terminate automatically upon the "
        "occurrence of a Milestone Default or the expiration of any cure period. Termination shall occur only upon "
        "Landlord's valid election under Section 10.5(e), and shall be effective as of the date specified in "
        "Landlord's notice, which shall be not earlier than the date of the notice.")
    sub(doc, "(g)", "**Conditions to Termination.** Notwithstanding any election by Landlord, no termination of this "
        "Lease on account of a Milestone Default shall be effective unless and until each of the following has been "
        "satisfied: (i) all notices required by Sections 9.3 and 10.5 have been delivered to each Leasehold "
        "Mortgagee; (ii) each Lender Cure Period has expired without cure; (iii) the period for a Leasehold Mortgagee "
        "to request a New Lease under Section 9.6 has expired without a request, or each Leasehold Mortgagee has "
        "waived its New Lease right in writing; (iv) the Improvement Payment has been paid in full or is secured in "
        "the manner provided in Section 10.6(d); and (v) Landlord is not then in default of any of its obligations "
        "under this Lease.")
    sub(doc, "(h)", "**No Termination After Substantial Completion.** Landlord shall have no right to terminate this "
        "Lease on account of a failure to achieve Milestone 3 if Substantial Completion of Phase 1 has been achieved "
        "before the effective date of any such termination, notwithstanding the existence of punch-list items or "
        "incomplete tenant fit-out, and any such termination shall be void.")
    sub(doc, "(i)", "**Wrongful Termination.** If Landlord purports to terminate this Lease on account of a Milestone "
        "Default other than in strict compliance with this Section 10.5, such termination shall be void, Tenant may "
        "obtain specific performance and injunctive relief, and Landlord shall indemnify Tenant and each Leasehold "
        "Mortgagee for all resulting losses, including financing costs, carry costs and lost profits.")
    sec(doc, "10.6", "Improvement Payment upon Termination for Milestone Default", "If this Lease is terminated on "
        "account of a Milestone Default in accordance with Section 10.5, then, as a condition to the effectiveness of "
        "such termination and in consideration of the transfer to Landlord of Tenant's Improvements and leasehold "
        "estate:")
    sub(doc, "(a)", "**Payment Obligation.** Landlord shall pay to Tenant (or, at Tenant's direction, to each "
        "Leasehold Mortgagee in accordance with its interest) an amount (the \"**Improvement Payment**\") equal to "
        "**the greater of** (i) the Appraised Value of the Improvements as of the Termination Date, determined in "
        "accordance with Section 10.8, and (ii) Tenant's Unreimbursed Hard Costs; less (iii) all insurance proceeds, "
        "condemnation awards and other recoveries theretofore received by or for the account of Tenant in respect of "
        "the Improvements and not applied to restoration; and less (iv) Landlord's Documented Damages determined in "
        "accordance with Section 10.7.")
    sub(doc, "(b)", "**Expression of Intent.** The parties agree that the Improvement Payment is intended to insure "
        "that Landlord does not acquire the Improvements, and the substantial value represented by them, without "
        "compensation, and that the Improvement Payment does not exceed a reasonable forecast of Landlord's "
        "compensable interest and is not a penalty. The parties further agree that Landlord's actual damages arising "
        "from a Milestone Default are limited to delay in the receipt of Rent and the other items described in "
        "Section 10.7, and that the uncompensated retention of Improvements having a value of $200,000,000 or more "
        "would bear no reasonable relationship to those damages.")
    sub(doc, "(c)", "**Security and Possession.** Landlord shall pay the Improvement Payment within sixty (60) days "

    # ================= ARTICLE 13 =================
    pagebreak(doc)
    art(doc, "Article 13. Casualty and Condemnation")
    sec(doc, "13.1", "Casualty; Restoration", "If the Improvements are damaged or destroyed by fire or other casualty, "
        "Tenant shall promptly notify Landlord and each Leasehold Mortgagee, and shall restore the Improvements "
        "substantially to their condition before the casualty (subject to Applicable Law then in effect, including "
        "any floodplain or freeboard requirement then applicable), using available insurance proceeds, provided that "
        "Tenant shall not be required to restore if (a) this Lease is terminated in accordance with Section 13.3 or "
        "(b) the Leasehold Mortgagee directs that proceeds be applied to the indebtedness secured by its Leasehold "
        "Mortgage.")
    sec(doc, "13.2", "Rent Abatement", "During the period of restoration following a casualty, Base Rent and "
        "Percentage Rent shall abate in proportion to the portion of the rentable area of the Improvements rendered "
        "unusable and not actually used by Tenant, measured on a rentable square footage basis, from the date of the "
        "casualty until the earlier of the date restoration is substantially complete and the date Tenant reoccupies "
        "the affected space. Insurance proceeds received by Tenant under the rent loss coverage shall be applied first "
        "to the abated Rent; any excess shall be retained by Tenant.")
    sec(doc, "13.3", "Termination Rights on Casualty", "If (a) restoration would require expenditures exceeding fifty "

        "(10) years of the Term, (c) the Improvements cannot be restored to a condition suitable for the Permitted "
        "Uses within twenty-four (24) months, or (d) applicable law would prohibit restoration as a practical matter, "
        "then either party may terminate this Lease by written notice delivered within ninety (90) days after the "
        "casualty. Upon any such termination, all insurance proceeds (other than those payable under the rent loss "
        "coverage) shall be paid to Tenant or, to the extent of its interest, to each Leasehold Mortgagee, and Landlord "
        "shall have no claim to them. Tenant shall have no obligation to rebuild in the event of a termination under "
        "this Section 13.3.")
    sec(doc, "13.4", "Condemnation", "If all or any part of the Premises or the Improvements is taken by eminent "
        "domain, or conveyed in lieu of condemnation under threat of condemnation, then:")
    sub(doc, "(a)", "the entire award, including any award for the fee interest, the leasehold interest, the "
        "Improvements, relocation costs, business interruption and loss of goodwill, shall be allocated between the "
        "parties as follows: Landlord shall receive the portion of the award attributable to the value of the land as "
        "unimproved and unencumbered by this Lease, determined as of the date of valuation, and Tenant shall receive "
        "all remaining portions of the award, including the portion attributable to the value of the leasehold "
        "interest, the Improvements, the Environmental Remediation Work, relocation costs and business interruption;")

    pf.space_before = Pt(16); pf.space_after = Pt(8); pf.keep_with_next = True

    runs(p, ((num + "  ") if num else "") + text, bold=True, size=10.5)
